messages:
incident-bot: PAGER -> P1 - inference-api high 5xx rate (svc: /v1/generate). Alert ID INC-451234. Auto-threshold triggered: 5xx spike + tail latency increase. Please page on-call and assemble war room. https://alerts.redwood/INC-451234
Alex (oncall): ack - receiving pager, joining war room now. War room: https://warroom.redwood/451234 (password in 1Password).
Sam (eng-sre): I'm online. Triage plan: check replicas, recent deploys, and kvcache eviction logs. Assigning myself as short-term owner unless Alex prefers.
Alex (oncall): assigning owner -> Sam, I'll stay on standby for handoff in 10m. Paging infra to confirm autoscale/queue health.
Tay (eng-infra): on it. Looking at scheduler and GPU pool. Early telemetry shows request queue backing on pool-gpu-a, cpu load ok. Suspect onboarding of a heavy prompt batch from a customer.
Leo (customer-support): customer telemetry: AcmeCorp shows ~38% requests returning 502/503 on embedding route since 08:12 UTC. A few other customers show degraded latency but lower error rates.
Maria (product): severity check: if multiple customers >30% errors we should publish status page as "partial outage". Drafting short note. Who will post?
Alex (oncall): I can post the status page update once we confirm affected subsystems. Draft text suggestion: "We are investigating increased errors and latency for the inference API. Some requests may fail or be delayed. Engineers are actively investigating. We'll post updates every 15 minutes."
Sam (eng-sre): initial quick actions executed: 1) rolled back last commit to model-routing (deployed 07:58) as precaution. 2) scaled pool-gpu-a +1 replica (manual). 3) cleared kv cache nodes showing eviction storms. Noted immediate reduction in 5xx on a subset of traffic.
Tay (eng-infra): autoscaler metrics show anomaly: scale-up suppressed due to cooldown logic combined with recent manual drains. We're overriding cooldown to add 2 replicas now.
Leo (customer-support): I'm drafting a proactive customer message for AcmeCorp: "We're investigating increased request failures on the inference API. Engineers are working on mitigation; we will update you within 30 minutes. If you want immediate mitigation, we can route traffic to a dedicated model variant temporarily." Want approval before sending.
Maria (product): approve the AcmeCorp draft. Add note: include workaround to reduce batch sizes and disable long-context requests.
Alex (oncall): Confirmed who posts what: I will post the status page with the draft above. Leo send the customer note to AcmeCorp once Sam confirms mitigation progress. Sam to provide ETA for full recovery.
Sam (eng-sre): current ETA ~25-35m if scale/eviction fixes hold. Continuing diagnostics on model-routing component to ensure no further regressions.
Tay (eng-infra): infra changes applied, additional replicas coming online in ~2m. Observability: queue depth dropping, error rate trending down from 40% -> ~12% in recent window.
incident-bot: Reminder: create incident doc INC-451234 and mark "on-call -> sam" in tracker.
Alex (oncall): created incident doc and linked war room. Next update in 10 minutes or on major milestone.
Leo (customer-support): sent AcmeCorp message and added note to their ticket: "we will follow up with root cause and timeline".
Maria (product): preparing status page follow-up copy for 15m with mitigation notes + suggested RCA owner (Sam).
Sam (eng-sre): continuing root-cause: suspect combination of kvcache eviction + controller race on model-routing causing timeouts. Will collect logs and open RCA workspace once service stable.
Alex (oncall): good. If error rate <5% and queue depth normalize, transition to monitoring mode and close war room. Keep this thread for updates.
Tay (eng-infra): confirming last checks: replicas stable, no recent failed deploys on infra layer. Holding watch.
Sam (eng-sre): marking mitigation progress: 80% of traffic healthy, continuing observations for 10m before closing.
Alex (oncall): thanks all. Logging handoff notes to incident doc and notifying postmortem owner tag (sam).
